stories.title: UP ATS arrests 4 suspects over terror blast conspiracy:Were planning blasts in hospitals and schools on Pakistani don’s orders
stories.summary: UP ATS and STF have arrested 4 suspected terrorists linked to Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti's sleeper cell. The investigation has revealed that the accused were in contact with handlers based in Pakistan through social media and video calling apps. They were sharing information about sensitive locations in the country. A case has been registered against the accused at the ATS police station located in Lucknow. Arrests from Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, and Haridwar ATS and STF have arrested Mahkab and Shahrukh, residents of Saharanpur, Gagandeep Singh alias Guri Singh, resident of Muzaffarnagar, and Musharraf, resident of Haridwar. According to the agencies, all four accused were connected to Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti's sleeper cell network. Were in contact with Pakistani handlers through social media and video calling According to investigating agencies, the accused were in contact with handlers based in Pakistan through social media platforms and video calling apps. Through these, they were conducting reconnaissance of sensitive locations, hospitals, and other important places, and sending information. Agencies have also received inputs during the investigation that the accused were working to connect youth with terrorist and sleeper cell networks. Some evidence related to a conspiracy to carry out terrorist incidents has also emerged in the preliminary investigation. Meeting took place in Noida, preparations were underway to procure weapons According to ATS sources, Mahkab and Gagandeep met in Noida in March. The investigation has also revealed that both were trying to arrange weapons for terrorist activities. Agencies are also conducting an in-depth investigation of the accused's digital devices and contacts. Network active on ISI's instructions Investigation agencies claim that gangsters Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt were running a conspiracy to connect youth in India to their network on the instructions of the Pakistani intelligence agency ISI. ATS will now take the accused into custody, remand, and investigate the entire network.

stories.title: UP ATS- STF arrests 4 suspects over terror conspiracy:Pakistani don assigned task to bomb BJP office, hospitals and schools
stories.summary: The Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) and Special Task Force (STF) on Wednesday arrested four suspected terrorists linked to a Pakistani terror module in Uttar Pradesh. The accused were allegedly plotting blasts at BJP offices, hospitals, schools, and several other sensitive locations. Two of the suspects are residents of Saharanpur, while the other two belong to Haridwar and Muzaffarnagar. According to agencies, the accused were in contact with Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt at the behest of Pakistan’s intelligence agency ISI. During interrogation, accused Mehkaab and Gagandeep alias Guri revealed: “They used to talk with Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt through Instagram. Abid Jatt had asked them to conduct reconnaissance of a political party office in UP, hospitals and a person who owns several schools, with the intention of targeting and blowing them up. Abid also told them that after completing this task, they would be given the next target.” Investigating agencies claim to have recovered crucial evidence against all four accused. A case has been registered against them at the ATS police station in Lucknow. Arrests made from Saharanpur and nearby areas According to UP ATS, the four accused were arrested on May 26, 2026, during a joint operation conducted in Saharanpur and adjoining areas. The arrested men have been identified as Mehkaab from Saharanpur, Gagandeep alias Guri Singh from Muzaffarnagar, Shahrukh from Saharanpur, and Musharraf from Haridwar. The accused were allegedly connected to the network of Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti and were working as sleeper cells for him. During questioning, it emerged that they were in touch with Pakistani handlers through social media platforms and video-calling applications. The accused are also alleged to have conducted reconnaissance of sensitive locations, recruited youths into the network, and conspired to carry out terror activities. The investigation is currently underway. Meeting held in Noida, plans to arrange weapons According to ATS sources, Mehkaab and Gagandeep had met in Noida in March. Investigation has further revealed that both were trying to arrange weapons for terrorist activities. A case under serious sections has been registered at the ATS police station in Lucknow. Agencies are also conducting a detailed examination of the accused persons’ digital devices and contacts. Investigating agencies claim that the Pakistani intelligence agency ISI, through gangsters Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt, was conspiring to recruit Indian youths into its network. ATS will now seek custody remand of the accused to probe the entire network in detail.

stories.title: Property dealer shot dead in Lucknow:Rapid firing took place in front of office; 2 criminals fled with pistol
stories.summary: In the PGI police station area of Lucknow, a property dealer was shot and killed. The criminals fled from the scene, brandishing pistols. People nearby immediately admitted the injured to the Apex Trauma Center, where he died during treatment. The incident occurred on Wednesday afternoon in the Kalli West area. Dainik Bhaskar has obtained exclusive CCTV footage of the incident, which shows the fearless criminals firing multiple shots at the property dealer. The property dealer has been identified as Sandeep Singh, a resident of Jaunpur. Police who arrived after receiving information about the murder are engaged in investigating the case. 4 images of the incident Property dealer Sandeep Singh was originally a resident of Jaunpur. He lives with his family near Kalindi Park. On Wednesday afternoon, between 12 and 12:30 pm, he reached his office in Yadav Market, located in Kalli West Market, with his driver, Pradeep Singh. It is being told that Sandeep had just gotten out of the car and was heading towards the office. Just then, 2 masked criminals riding an Apache bike arrived there. They fired at him indiscriminately. As soon as the bullet hit, Sandeep fell down injured, while the accused fled from the spot. The biker criminal was wearing a helmet According to local shopkeepers, the biker criminals who carried out the attack came in a very professional manner. The criminal riding the bike was wearing a helmet, while the attacker sitting behind had covered his face with a cloth. After committing the crime, the accused fled from the spot quickly. This makes it clear that the attackers were professional criminals. The injured Sandeep Singh's family includes his wife Preeti Singh, son Sarthak Singh, and daughter, CV Singh. Police have recovered a bullet shell from the crime scene A 50-second CCTV footage of the incident has been obtained. It shows the property dealer Sandeep getting out of the car. After that, he moves forward while talking on his mobile. During this time, a criminal wearing a white shirt and blue jeans approaches him and starts firing rapidly at him. As soon as the first bullet hits near his chest, he falls on the road. Even after that, he continues firing. At the end, he fires a bullet near his head. He sits with his accomplice, who was standing with the bike started a few steps away, and flees. People nearby took him to the hospital. Police engaged in identification based on CCTV ADCP South and ACP Goshaiganj reached the spot with the police force. Officers questioned the employees present in the property dealer's office. Police say that efforts are being made to identify the attackers based on CCTV footage. In the initial investigation, several angles, including personal enmity, are being investigated. DCP South Amit Kumar Anand said- Information was received around 1 PM today about Sandeep Singh being shot. CCTV footage has been examined. Two bike-riding youths who shot Sandeep have been spotted. A case is being registered based on the complaint.

stories.title: BJP leader made obscene videos of woman doctor:Victim alleges, 'I was drugged and assaulted in hospital'; expelled from party
stories.summary: A BJP leader made an objectionable video of a woman doctor in Bijnor. Then he kept blackmailing her. The doctor alleges that he mixed intoxicants in her food and fed it to her. He shot obscene videos and then kept extorting money by threatening her. After the woman doctor's complaint, the police have registered a case against BJP leader Prabhat Yadav under serious sections. Prabhat is a district minister of the BJP. The doctor works at the Mother Child Care Hospital in the city. Meanwhile, after the FIR was filed, BJP district president Bhupendra Chauhan expelled Prabhat Yadav from the party. The case is from the Chandpur police station area. Now read the complete case in detail... Meder Care Hospital is in Chandpur. The hospital belongs to a BAMS female doctor. She runs the hospital together with her doctor father-in-law. On July 29, 2025, the female doctor's husband passed away. The female doctor said that BJP leader Prabhat Yadav, a resident of Rohania village, used to frequently come to my hospital with his wife. After the acquaintance grew, he also started coming and going to the house frequently. Everything remained normal for about 6 months. After my husband's death, he showed sympathy and support. During this time, his intentions and actions did not seem right to me. Therefore, I forbade him from coming to the house and hospital, but he did not listen. Made obscene video 3 months ago The doctor alleges that about 3 months ago, Prabhat came to the hospital. He gave me something to eat mixed with an intoxicating substance. He mixed an intoxicating substance in my food and drink, due to which I became unconscious. After this, he made objectionable photos and videos of me in the hospital itself. When I regained consciousness, I was alone in the room. The doctor said that later, Prabhat Yadav sent me my obscene photos and videos. He started threatening to make them viral. When I asked him to delete the videos, he started demanding money by threatening me. Due to this, I became mentally disturbed. He continued to harass me mentally, physically, and financially for a long time. Also threatened in-laws and parents I also told this to my in-laws and parents. When they tried to talk to the BJP leader, he started threatening them, too. After this, I filed a complaint with the police. The woman doctor has demanded security, citing a threat to her life from BJP leader Prabhat Yadav. BJP leader says, ‘Being framed in a conspiracy’ Accused Prabhat Yadav called the allegations against him baseless. He said that I am being framed as part of a conspiracy. The allegations made against me are false. I have not done anything wrong. Chandpur police station in-charge Inspector Rahul Singh said- A case has been registered against Prabhat Yadav under serious sections. Efforts are being made to arrest the accused. The woman doctor has also been called for a statement. Prabhat's brother is in the Army, father retired from Forest Department Prabhat Yadav has 2 brothers. The younger brother is in the Army. His father is retired from the post of driver in the Forest Department. His first wife has passed away. He has one daughter and one son from his second wife. Prabhat was the president of Chandpur assembly constituency in the Samajwadi Party in 2017. He left SP and joined the BJP in 2018.

stories.title: 'Shahrukh', 'Salman' living luxury life in AC:Get ice cream to beat the heat, Sultan sold for ₹90,000 in Gorakhpur ahead of Bakrid
stories.summary: As Eid-ul-Adha, also known as Bakrid, approaches in Gorakhpur, the goat markets have become fully bustling. Shopping is taking place from morning till late night in several areas including Jama Masjid Urdu Bazaar, Jafra Bazaar, Ilahibagh, Zahidabad, Khoonipura, and Rahmtnagar. Heavy crowds of people are thronging the markets. Some are selecting goats based on weight while others are buying based on breed and beauty. This time, there is particularly high demand for goats of special breeds, heavy weight, and large size. Goats of Desi, Barbari, Jamunapari, and Totapari breeds are attracting people greatly in the markets. 'Shahrukh' and 'Salman' become the talk of the area Mohammad Kashif, a resident of the city, has purchased two goats for 55 thousand rupees. He has named both of them "Shahrukh" and "Salman". Both goats have now become a topic of discussion in the area. Whoever sees them stops to look at them. People from the neighborhood and children are especially coming to Kashif's house to see both goats. Many people are also taking photos and videos with them. Sitting on sofa, playing with the children Kashif explained that both goats are being cared for like family members. Considering the heat and humidity, separate AC and cooler arrangements have been made for them. They are not taken outside during the intense heat of the day. Most of the time, both rest in the room. Sometimes they are seen sitting on the sofa, and sometimes playing with the children of the house. Both goats are also eating ice cream in the heat Kashif mentioned that "Shahrukh" and "Salman" are quite fond of ice cream. To provide relief from the heat, they are fed ice cream from time to time, which both eat with great relish. Besides this, they are also being given gram, green grass, bel leaves, and nutritious feed. The family members are taking complete care of their cleanliness and diet so that the heat does not affect them. ₹90,000 goat becomes center of attraction Abdullah, who arrived at the Bakra Bazaar from Rahmatnagar late Tuesday evening, purchased a goat for ₹90,000. His goat also became the center of attraction for people in the market. Due to its large size and heavy weight, people were seen stopping to look at it. There was considerable discussion among people present in the market about its price and weight. Traders say that this year the demand for expensive and good breed goats has increased more compared to last year. Many people are also booking their preferred goats in advance. Prices reaching up to 1 lakh According to traders, ordinary goats are being sold for seven to ten thousand rupees. The price of good breed and heavy weight goats is reaching above 20 thousand rupees. Special breed goats are being sold from 25 thousand to 1 lakh rupees. The price of many large and heavier goats is said to be even more than this. There is also a lot of bargaining going on between buyers and traders in the markets. Attracting Customers with Filmy Names To attract customers, traders are also giving different names to goats. Some are named "Salman", some "Tiger", "Sultan" and "Sheru". Children and youth are showing great interest in taking photos and videos with these named goats. Booking Started for Shares in Large Animals Along with goats, people have also started preparations for sacrificing large animals. Ali Ghazanfar Shah of Rahmatnagar informed that people are depositing money in advance for shares in large animals. This year, rates of ₹3500, ₹4000 and ₹4500 are being charged for one share. He mentioned that the sacrifice will be performed according to Shariat and people can also perform Aqeeqa. Sacrifice continues for 3 days Senior teacher Mohammad Azam of Khokhar Tola informed that in the city, the sacrifice continues for three days every year. One buffalo is sacrificed on behalf of seven people. There is considerable enthusiasm among people regarding this. With Bakrid approaching, the crowds in the city's markets are continuously increasing. As evening falls, the number of people in the markets grows even more. Traders say that shopping will intensify in the next few days and the prices of good breed goats may also increase.

stories.title: Debris from hotel kills manager in Lucknow:Was heading to office, leaves behind wife and two children
stories.summary: The manager of a Maruti showroom in Lucknow died after debris (a sack filled with hardened cement chunks) fell on his head. He was passing in front of a hotel on Tuesday while going to the office. Just then, someone threw a sack filled with debris from the second floor of the hotel, which fell directly on his head. The manager's head split open. He fell unconscious to the ground. People present nearby took him to Lohia Hospital, where he died during treatment. The incident occurred at Vasundhara Vihar in Naubasta Kala, Chinhat. Police identified the deceased as Anoop Kumar Singh (36), a resident of Kundauli village in Deoria. He was a service manager at the Maruti showroom located at IT Chowraha. See 2 pictures... Now the complete incident in detail Vishal Tiwari has a hotel in Vasundhara Vihar Colony located in Naubasta Kala. Some cement kept here for construction had hardened due to water. Vishal, along with other colleagues, broke the cement into several pieces around eight in the morning. After this, the debris was filled in a sack and thrown from the second floor of the hotel without looking down. The sack fell on the head of Anoop Kumar Singh, who was passing in front of the hotel. His head split open. He fell unconscious. Police took the accused into custody After the accident, people from the colony immediately took the injured Anoop to Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, but he died during treatment. Upon receiving information, Chinhat police arrived and took Vishal Tiwari into custody and started interrogation. After conducting the post-mortem of the deceased, the police handed over the body to the family members. The family took the body to Deoria. Meanwhile, a case of culpable homicide not amounting to murder has been registered against the accused. Brother said- Hotel owner's people are pressuring Brother Shreyans said- My brother Anoop was working as a service manager at the Maruti showroom located at IT Chowraha. On Tuesday morning around 8 am, he had left home to go on duty. At that very spot, Vishal Tiwari threw cement debris from his hotel which fell directly on my brother's head. People present at the spot also made a video of him. After this, the building owner came down and started cleaning the ground. After this, Anoop was sent to Lohiya Hospital for treatment, but he died on the way. Many people known to the hotel owner came to the police station and started pressuring us to settle. Anoop was the sole breadwinner of the family Shreyaansh said that Anoop was the sole breadwinner of the family. Currently, his family includes his wife Richa, two small children Divyansh and Ayan. One child is 3 months old. His father is battling cancer. We will seek help from the administration. At least 50 lakh rupees of financial assistance should be given to the family. Strict action should be taken against the accused.

stories.title: 'Never walk in Agra', advises Russian tourist:Shares VIDEO of auto driver’s rude behaviour who kept calling out her 'madam.. madam'
stories.summary: A Russian tourist in Agra shared a video on Instagram, feeling uncomfortable while walking on the roadside. She advised against walking after being harassed by an auto driver on Yamuna Kinara Road. Kira wrote in Russian - We thought about walking on the streets of Agra, you should never do it. Now, the Russian female tourist has raised the issue of an uncomfortable experience by posting a video on Instagram. See 2 pictures In the video, the auto driver says 'Ma'am, ma'am'. On Tuesday, Russian tourist Kira Suvorovaa shared a video on her Instagram handle. This video was made on Yamuna Kinara Road. Kira is wearing a red dress and walking on Yamuna Kinara Road. Suddenly, an auto driver appears in front of her on the road. This makes her uncomfortable, and she walks past him, ignoring him. After this, the auto driver makes comments, calling out 'Ma'am, ma'am'. Users commented after the video surfaced After Kira shared the video from Agra, a user wrote - "Why do people coming from Russia only visit the poor areas of India?" In response, Kira said that she had visited different areas of Agra. While other users say that a large number of tourists from India and abroad visit the Taj city, such incidents damage the city's international image. People have demanded better behavior towards tourists and strengthening of road safety measures. 19.5K followers on Instagram Kira is quite active on Instagram. She has created an ID as Kira. Suvorova. Kira has 19.5K followers on Instagram. She has posted REELs of visiting several religious cities in the country. She has made 539 posts so far, while she follows 211 people.

stories.title: Car catches fire during charging in Ghaziabad:Smoke spreads in building, 15 escape by jumping to adjacent building
stories.summary: Massive fire breaks out during EV charging in Ghaziabad, smoke fills building, 15 people escape by jumping to neighbouring structure; probe on A major fire broke out late Tuesday night in Ghaziabad during the charging of an electric vehicle. The blaze quickly filled the entire building and stairwell with thick smoke, triggering panic among residents. The incident took place at A-77 Rampuri in Suryanagar under the Link Road police station area. On receiving the alert, four fire tenders from Vaishali and Sahibabad fire stations rushed to the spot. Amid the fire and heavy smoke, around 15 people trapped inside the building managed to save their lives by jumping into an adjacent building. Chief Fire Officer Rahul Pal, who reached the spot, said that all residents were safely evacuated and no casualties were reported. Firefighters managed to bring the blaze under control after nearly 25 minutes of effort. Fire erupts in a car while charging According to police and fire officials, an electric vehicle charging station operated by a private company was set up inside the building. An electric car was being charged at night when it suddenly caught fire. Within moments, a loud explosion-like sound was heard, causing panic in the surrounding area. Smoke fills the staircase Rakesh, a resident of the building, said that when he looked towards the staircase, he saw a car on the ground floor engulfed in flames. Smoke rapidly spread upwards, making it difficult to breathe. He then rushed upstairs, raised an alarm and woke up other residents. All of them managed to escape through a neighbouring building. Short circuit suspected as cause Preliminary investigation suggests that the fire may have been triggered by a short circuit during the charging process. However, the fire department is conducting a detailed probe into the incident.

stories.title: Scorpio crashes into tractor-trolley on Ganga Expressway:3 dead, 5 from same family injured, treatment underway
stories.summary: A Scorpio collided with a tractor-trolley on the Ganga Expressway in Raebareli district around 10:30 pm on late Tuesday night. According to the information, three people, including a grandmother and her two granddaughters who were travelling in the Scorpio, died in the accident. Five other members of the same family were seriously injured and were referred to a higher medical centre after first being taken to a nearby hospital. The impact of the collision was so severe that the front portion of the Scorpio was completely damaged, trapping all passengers inside the vehicle. Loud cries were heard at the scene, and nearby residents rushed after hearing a blast-like sound. Police and rescue teams were alerted, and the injured were pulled out after cutting open the vehicle’s door. The deceased have been identified as Sangeeta Singh (21), Samriddhi Singh (7) and their grandmother Saroj Singh (60). The injured include Gurcharan Singh (36), Neeraj Singh (42), Savita Singh (38), Pratibha Singh (32) and Samarth Singh (5). The family was travelling from Noida to Seelampur village in Jaunpur when the accident took place near the Salon police station area of Raebareli. 3 Photos- All aspects of the accident are being investigated Upon receiving information about the incident, CO Salwan and the police station team reached the spot. Officials visited the hospital to inquire about the condition of the injured. Police say that all aspects of the accident are being investigated. It will also be investigated why the tractor was standing there. Eyewitnesses say that the tractor-trolley was parked on the expressway. This might be related to the Expressway Authority. However, this has not been officially confirmed yet. Salon Kotwal Balendu Gautam said- Three people died in a road accident on the Ganga Expressway. Five people are injured. The injured were taken to the hospital for treatment. The condition of a 5-year-old child is said to be critical.

stories.title: Kasganj Sadhu beaten to death after asking for water:Accused lost temper over simple request; attacked twice; victim later died in hospital
stories.summary: In Kasganj, a sadhu was beaten to death by a local strongman after a dispute over a handpump. The sadhu had reportedly asked the man to operate the handpump for water, which angered him, leading to an attack. Although villagers initially rescued the sadhu, the accused later caught him again and severely assaulted him with a stick. The injured sadhu was taken to the hospital in critical condition, where doctors declared him dead late at night. The incident took place on Tuesday in Nagla Peepal village, around 30 kilometres from the district headquarters. Police have arrested the accused in the case. See pictures Know the full story 35-year-old Sadhu Vipin Kumar has been serving in the Mata temples in Nagla Pipal and Bharsoli villages for about 15 years. He stays in the temples all day and performs worship. The sadhu's sister is married in Nagla Pipal village itself. Brother-in-law Jaiprakash said- Between approximately 1:30 PM and 2 PM on Tuesday, Sadhu Vipin was sitting under a Peepal tree near the village temple. There was a handpump nearby. Feeling thirsty, he went to the handpump and asked Kaushal Kumar of Bhadpura, who was present there, to operate the tap. At this, Kaushal got angry. He said: You operate the tap yourself with your own powers. Following this, an argument ensued between the accused and the sadhu, and a fight broke out. However, people present nearby intervened and calmed the situation. Cornered at Tiharo shortly after According to the villagers, a feast was organised in Nagla Nalli village. Around 3 PM, Sadhu Vipin was going to attend it. He was waiting for a taxi at Bhadpura Tirahe. At the same time, the accused Kaushal arrived there. He attacked the sadhu with a stick. Due to this sudden attack, Vipin fell to the ground. After this, the accused hit the sadhu 7-8 times on the chest and back with a stick and beat him half to death with kicks and punches. Seeing the sadhu being beaten, people nearby rushed to the spot. They then rescued the sadhu from the accused. The seriously injured sadhu was taken to the district hospital. There, doctors admitted him and started treatment. According to the doctors, the sadhu had sustained deep head injuries in the attack. He also had injuries on his chest and back. Late at night, the sadhu succumbed to his injuries during treatment. Accused works for the mining mafia Meanwhile, after the death of the sadhu, the police became active and arrested the accused Kaushal. According to the police and villagers, the accused is in contact with mining mafias and acts as a strongman in the village.

stories.title: Trafficker attempting to sell child shot in Bareilly encounter:Frightened kid cries on road during gunfire; inspector rushes to rescue him
stories.summary: In Bareilly, police arrested two accused in an encounter while they were allegedly trying to sell a one-and-a-half-year-old child. The child was rescued safely from their possession. Both accused suffered bullet injuries in their legs during the operation. When police brought the child back to the family, the mother immediately ran towards him and hugged him. She broke down in tears and kept thanking the police with folded hands. The incident took place after the child went missing from outside his house three days ago, on Sunday (24 May). When he did not return for a long time, the family informed the police. CCTV footage was later checked, which showed two people kidnapping the child. Bareilly SP (South) Anshika Verma formed a team and started a search operation. Meanwhile, information was received that the kidnappers were going to sell the child. The police cordoned off the area. Meanwhile, late at night, two suspects were seen coming on a bike near Phulasi Tirahe in the city. When signaled to stop, they took a U-turn and started fleeing. There was also a small child with them. When the police chased, the bike skidded. The child fell into the bushes by the roadside. Seeing themselves surrounded, the accused opened fire. Policemen fired in retaliation and during this time inspector ran to save the child. He picked him up and took him away from the encounter spot. Head Constable Kaumish Kumar was also injured in the firing by the accused. The accused have been identified as Yogesh Kannaujia (28) from Shahjahanpur and Pawan Singh (25) from Badaun. Both have been arrested. Meanwhile, Bareilly SP (South) Anshika Verma took the child from the constable and held him in her lap. She caressed him for a long time. Then she handed him over to his family. The encounter took place at Phulasi Tirahe, about 15 kilometres from Manauna Dham. 3 Photos Now, understand the entire case in a sequential manner Raman, originally from Badaun, is an employee at Manauna Dham. He lives on rent near the Dham with his wife and 3 children. He stated - On the morning of May 24, at 10:30 AM, the children were playing near the temple premises. After some time, two children returned, but the one-and-a-half-year-old younger child did not return. After extensive searching, when he did not return, a complaint of kidnapping was filed at Aonla police station. Five police teams were formed to search for the child. After scanning CCTV footage, the police started raids in search of the accused, but no clue was found. On the night of May 26, the police received information from an informant that two people were in Phulasi village with a child. They were planning to take him to Delhi and sell him. The police tightened the cordon. During the check, 2 accused were seen coming with the child. Police arrested both of them in an encounter. Accused Yogesh stated during interrogation that he was pursuing an MSc Nursing from Shahjahanpur Medical College. During his studies, he met a patient from Lakhimpur who had come for a kidney stone operation. He said - you steal children up to 6 months old and give them to me, I will sell them to childless couples and give you 60 thousand rupees. Yogesh said - I contacted Pawan. We had been searching for newborns for several months. After that, we reached Manauna Dham. We had been doing reconnaissance for a month. After kidnapping the child, when we told the mastermind his age, he reprimanded us. He said that this child is about one and a half years old, and recognises his parents. No one will buy him. That's why we were taking him to someone else. Police are scrutinising the criminal record of the accused Police have recovered two illegal pistols, two spent cartridges, two live cartridges, and a numberless bike used in the kidnapping from the arrested accused. SP South Anshika Verma said- Within 48 hours, the abducted child was safely recovered and handed over to the family. Additionally, both accused have been arrested, and the process of sending them to jail has been initiated. The old criminal record of the criminals is also being scrutinized to ensure the strictest possible action against them.

stories.title: RSS chief visits Lucknow training camp:289 volunteers trained over 3 days with discipline exercises; ideology sessions at Nirala Nagar
stories.summary: After the Bengal elections, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has geared up to form the BJP government for the third time in UP. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat has emphasized taking Hindutva, along with the Sangh's idea of 'Panch Parivartan' (five changes), to every household. He said, The distinction of caste in society must be eliminated to promote Hindutva and nationalism. All castes will be respected, and care must be taken to ensure there is no discrimination against them at any level. Mohan Bhagwat had come to Lucknow to participate in the worker development class of the Sangh's eastern region. Staying for three days at Saraswati Shishu Mandir in Nirala Nagar, Mohan Bhagwat shared principles of discipline in life and methods to expand the Sangh's work with the trainee volunteers. He interacted with 289 volunteers who participated in the training class on Sunday, Monday, and Tuesday. Contact families and instil good values in children Under the 'Kutumb Prabodhan' (family enlightenment) initiative, the RSS chief emphasised strengthening the traditional joint family system and family values by curbing the growing trend of nuclear families. He said, contact families and instill good values in children, also give them education about Sanatan Dharma. Emphasizing environmental protection, he said, the era of climate change is ongoing, and temperatures are rising excessively. To stop these problems, environmental protection and planting more and more trees are the solutions. He said, It is also necessary to make people aware of their duties along with their rights. Every individual should fulfill their duties towards the nation and society. In the intellectual session, he resolved the volunteers' queries. He also emphasized making maximum contact with people and conveying the Sangh's ideology to them. He said that if someone wants to join the Sangh, they should be connected according to their convenience and the Sangh's plan. Volunteers will explain the reasons for rising inflation According to sources, during the Sangh chief's visit, issues of rising inflation, increasing petrol-diesel prices, and global recession were also deliberated upon. Sangh volunteers will inform the public that the Iran-America war is causing a global problem of petrol-diesel. Its impact is less in India compared to other countries. During inflation and recession, people should follow the guidelines issued by the government. Sangh will put full strength in UP According to sources, the Sangh chief also discussed coordination between the government, the Sangh, and the BJP during his interaction with Sangh officials from the eastern region. He was informed about the decisions taken in the coordination meeting held recently and their implementation. After the formation of the BJP government in West Bengal, the Sangh and BJP will now put all their strength into Uttar Pradesh. Forming a government in Uttar Pradesh is most crucial for the Sangh and BJP. Bhagwat, like a young volunteer, even at 75 years of age The Sangh chief maintained a daily routine similar to that of the young volunteers participating in the worker development camp. From 4:30 AM until the lamp immersion at 10 PM, he participated in the shakha, exercises, and intellectual sessions. During his three-day visit, Bhagwat did not meet any political figure from the government. Earlier, during his two-day visit, he had met CM Yogi Adityanath, and both Deputy CMs, Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak.

stories.title: Over 6,000 UP gun licence holders face criminal charges:Raja Bhaiya, Brijbhushan and Ansari own weapons; licences remain under govt review
stories.summary: The image is from October 2, 2025. More than 200 indigenous and foreign weapons were displayed on a table as Raghuraj Pratap Singh, MLA from Kunda in Pratapgarh district, performed Shastra Puja on Vijayadashami (Dussehra). Speaking to the media after the ritual, he said that all the weapons belonged to him and his supporters. He added that what belongs to him also belongs to his supporters, and what belongs to his supporters is also his. According to the rules, a person can keep a maximum of 2 licensed weapons, provided they do not have a criminal record. However, in UP, more than 6,000 people have licensed weapons, against whom serious criminal cases are registered. These include strongman leaders like Raja Bhaiya, Dhananjay Singh, and Brijbhushan Sharan Singh. Many have more weapons than the prescribed limit. Recently, after a strict remark by the Allahabad High Court, data is being collected at the government level on what basis licenses were issued even after cases were filed. Wife's allegation - Raja Bhaiya has a cache of weapons Several cases have been registered against Raja Bhaiya under serious sections like attempt to murder, abuse, and death threats. Despite this, he has 3 weapons registered in his name. According to the affidavit submitted in the 2022 assembly elections, he possesses one pistol, one rifle, and one gun. However, his wife Bhanvi Singh had released a video in September 2025, alleging that Raja Bhaiya has a cache of illegal weapons. Similarly, strongman Brijbhushan Sharan Singh, who was an MP from Gonda's Kaiserganj seat, also possesses 3 weapons. According to the affidavit filed in the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, he has one pistol, one rifle, and one repeater gun. Several criminal cases, including TADA, have been registered against him. However, he has been acquitted in all cases. MLA Abbas Ansari possesses 8 weapons Abbas Ansari, son of Mukhtar Ansari and MLA from Mau, has 10 cases registered against him under various sections including hate speech, threatening officials, money laundering, Arms Act, and gangster act. Despite this, he once possessed 8 weapons. These included a double-barrel gun, rifle, revolver, pistol, and sports rifle. Abbas was granted a license because he was a national-level shooter (player). Under the Arms Act, a shooter can easily obtain a license. On this basis, Abbas purchased 8 weapons, which also included firearms of prohibited bore. Abbas is also accused of purchasing weapons and barrels from abroad without proper permits. He continued to buy weapons even after quitting shooting in 2015. Regarding this, a case was registered at the Mahanagar police station in Lucknow in 2019. The STF had filed a charge sheet under the Arms Act. Since then, all weapons have been in police custody. What are the rules for possessing weapons? After the changes in the Arms Act rules in 2020, a common citizen can keep a maximum of 2 weapons on one license. These can also be of different types. However, approval from the District Magistrate is required. Even if someone has inherited weapons, the total number cannot exceed 2. Additional weapons must be surrendered. Earlier, 3 weapons could be kept on one license. Meanwhile, National/International shooters (players) can keep a maximum of 12 weapons depending on different levels. If a shooter plays one type of shooting sport, they can keep a maximum of 8 weapons (previously 4). If they play 2 types of shooting sports, they can keep a maximum of 10 weapons (previously 7), and if they play more than 2 types of shooting sports, they can keep a maximum of 12 weapons (previously 7). Individuals with a criminal record do not get a license Former UP DGP Sulkhan Singh says - It is also true that usually, those who have licensed firearms are not attacked. As far as giving licenses to criminals is concerned, a police station report is necessary for this. Generally, if a case is registered against someone, they do not get a license. In most cases, the District Magistrate does not issue a license against the police station's report. The reason for this is that if a major incident occurs with a licensed weapon, there is a possibility of the DM getting into trouble. How were licenses obtained even after cases were registered? Regarding criminals getting licenses, Sulkhan Singh says- It is possible that the license was obtained before the case was registered. The District Magistrate, at their discretion, can also grant a license by overlooking the police station's report. There is no rule against issuing a license if a case is registered, provided the person is not a convicted criminal. How is a license obtained? In UP, to obtain a weapon license, one applies on the basis of self-defense or sport (shooting). One can apply online on the ALIS portal or offline at the DM/Commissioner's office. For this, ID proof, address proof, age certificate, income certificate, and physical/mental fitness certificate are required. The reason for acquiring the weapon also needs to be stated. The age must be at least 21 years. After the form is submitted, the police and Local Intelligence Unit (LIU) check the background. If the police report is found to be correct, you may be called for a DM interview. Upon approval, the license is issued. The license is valid for 5 years. After this, it needs to be renewed. Fees have to be paid based on the type of weapon (e.g., revolver, pistol, gun).

stories.title: Heatwave alert in 34 UP districts, storms in 16:Weather shift expected during Nautapa; temperature may fall 8°C
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is currently witnessing two different weather patterns. In the Purvanchal region, strong winds and rain have brought some relief from the intense heat. At the same time, Banda in Bundelkhand recorded a temperature of 47.4°C, making it the hottest place in the country. People in western Uttar Pradesh are also facing severe heat conditions. However, on Tuesday night, storms and rain provided some relief in Agra and Mathura, while other areas continued to suffer from high temperatures. On Wednesday, bright sunshine was seen across the state from the morning. Due to low wind speed, humidity levels have increased, adding to discomfort. An alert for storms and rain has been issued in 16 districts. A heatwave warning has also been issued for 34 districts. A red alert has been declared in six districts Agra, Jalaun, Jhansi, Banda, Hamirpur and Mahoba, where extremely hot winds are expected. According to the Meteorological Department, relief from the ongoing severe heat is likely from tomorrow as a new western disturbance is expected to change weather conditions over the next week. Storms, thunder, lightning and rain are likely in several areas, and hailstorms may also occur at some places. This could bring a temperature drop of 6°C to 8°C and ease the heatwave conditions. Due to the heat and heatwave, people faced difficulties throughout the day. We will provide weather details below, but before that, read this news about taking care of your health during Nautapa… See pictures Why is there rain in some parts of UP and scorching heat in others? Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said- A new Western Disturbance will become active on May 28. A cyclonic circulation persists at higher altitudes over South Bihar and adjoining areas. In such a situation, the spell of thunderstorms and rain may continue in the state for the next one week. Wind speed can reach up to 50-60 km/hr. How will the weather be for the next 5 days?

stories.title: ONGC says Ganga Basin oil claims are exaggerated:Discoveries in UP and Bihar termed minor; India betting big on Andaman deep sea mission
stories.summary: Amid rising petrol and diesel prices in the country, discussions over the discovery of oil and natural gas in Ballia in Uttar Pradesh and Samastipur in Bihar have gained momentum. Locally, it is being projected as a major energy discovery. However, a senior official from ONGC headquarters in Dehradun, in an interview with Dainik Bhaskar, described these claims as mere “news hype” from a technical point of view. The official said no such results have been found so far in the Ganga Basin that can be treated as a large commercial project. According to the official, the real exploration story is unfolding in the deep-sea areas of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, where a multi-billion-rupee high-risk mission is currently underway under the direct supervision of the Indian government. What was found in the Ganga Basin, and why ONGC is not considering it significant According to the official, locally, a gas flow of 40 thousand cubic meters is being described as a major discovery, whereas ONGC's total daily production is about 6 to 6.5 crore cubic meters. Compared to that, this discovery is very small. He said that drilling of 3000 or 3500 meters is being portrayed as very significant in the media, whereas ONGC has already drilled up to 6000 meters in Gujarat, Rajahmundry, and even 30 years ago in Kashmir. For hydrocarbon exploration in the country, ONGC has divided basins into three categories. Currently, the Ganga Basin is placed in the third category. According to the official, until the Director General of Hydrocarbons certifies a discovery, the discovery of small gas pockets is not considered to have significant commercial importance. India's Largest Oil-Gas Mission in Andaman According to the official, most of the large oil and gas reserves discovered in recent years worldwide have been found in deep sea. India is also now running a major mission in the Andaman-Nicobar region on the same model. The cost of drilling a single well here is reaching ₹1100 to ₹1200 crore. The daily rent for a drilling rig alone is about ₹5 crore. In the sea, the first 500 to 1000 meters is only water depth. After this, pipelines have to be laid up to about 7000 feet below the seabed for drilling. When the weather is bad, both the risk and the cost increase many times over. This area is so far from the Indian mainland that even helicopters cannot reach there directly. ONGC has arranged chartered planes for this. The Indian Navy and Air Force are also being assisted for logistics and security support. Know what has been found in the Andaman so far in 3 points Why is India taking such a big risk? India currently imports over 90% of its crude oil requirements from abroad. Natural gas imports have also reached nearly 60%. For this reason, the country is placing a big bet on domestic exploration. However, oil and gas exploration is called "big gambling" in the industry, because even after spending thousands of crores, there is no guarantee of results. According to the official, many large private companies have withdrawn from bidding for new blocks due to the fear of losing up to ?10,000 crore. Now, the responsibility for large-scale exploration rests solely with ONGC. The official gave an example, stating that American company ExxonMobil discovered a large oil reserve in the offshore area of the South American country Guyana after 58 unsuccessful attempts. That discovery transformed the entire economy of the small country. India is also making significant investments in the Andaman region with the same hope, as geographically this area is considered close to Indonesia's large oil and gas reserves. ONGC's challenge abroad is also significant According to the official, ONGC Videsh Limited is managing oil and gas blocks in about 17 countries around the world, but due to war, sanctions, and diplomatic situations, India is not able to fully benefit from these investments. In 2021, ONGC discovered one of the world's largest gas fields in Iran, but due to diplomatic circumstances, India did not get the development rights there. India has a significant stake in Russia's oil blocks, but due to US sanctions, it is not easy to bring oil directly from there. The company adjusts the profits made there in the local market. Meanwhile, ONGC's many projects are affected in countries like Sudan, Syria, and Iraq due to war and internal instability. An investment of about 2 billion dollars, or approximately ₹16 thousand crore, in Mozambique is also stuck in an unstable region. Bombay High is still India's biggest strength ONGC's total domestic production in the country is about 3.5 lakh barrels per day. Of this, Bombay High alone, along with its surrounding Neelam and Bassein Satellite Fields, accounts for 2.22 lakh barrels of production. In terms of onshore production, Gujarat's Ahmedabad and Mehsana blocks are performing better. Some amount of gas production is also happening from Madhya Pradesh's 'Hatta Field', but its level is still limited. Why doesn't the government reduce the tax on petrol and diesel? When an official was asked why the government doesn't reduce tax on petrol-diesel, he said that oil and gas exploration is a very risky business. Many times, even after spending thousands of crores of rupees, no results are found. According to the official, to manage this huge risk and investment, the government needs a consistently large revenue. The government deliberately imposes heavy taxes on oil so that people consume it in moderation and shift towards electric vehicles, public transport, or alternative energy. He said that only those Gulf countries can provide cheap oil where the population is very low and production is extremely high. This model is not easy for a large consumer country like India.

stories.title: UP govt to give free Scooties to 50,000 girls:Not sure if these are for 1st time voters, petrol models or EVs, yet to be decided
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath-led Uttar Pradesh government is preparing to roll out a major welfare initiative ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections by distributing free scooties to more than 50,000 meritorious girls this year. The move is aimed at fulfilling a key promise made in the BJP’s 2022 election manifesto. The government has already earmarked ₹400 crore for the scheme. Political observers believe the initiative could offer the BJP three major advantages ahead of the elections: Debate continues over EV Or petrol scooters Officials are reportedly leaning towards electric scooters, arguing that petrol scooters would increase fuel expenses for students. Electric vehicles would reduce commuting costs for girls traveling to colleges and ease the financial burden on families. However, some officials have raised concerns about charging infrastructure in rural areas, where access to charging stations may remain limited. Durability and affordability key factors The government is planning to procure low-cost yet durable scooters from automobile manufacturers so that students can use them for a long period without high maintenance costs. Eligibility criteria under discussion According to Higher Education Minister Yogendra Upadhyay, discussions are underway on two major eligibility conditions. Academic performance The government is considering whether the scheme should cover: Family income limit Officials are also planning to introduce an income ceiling so that the benefits reach students from poor and middle-class families instead of affluent households. Earlier budget allocation had lapsed The BJP had promised the ‘Rani Laxmibai Scooter Distribution Scheme’ in its 2022 manifesto. The government had allocated ₹400 crore for the scheme in the 2025-26 financial year as well, but the budget lapsed because eligibility rules could not be finalized in time. The state government has now once again allocated ₹400 crore in the new financial year. Automobile companies await tender process Major two-wheeler manufacturers, including Hero MotoCorp, TVS Motor Company, Ola Electric, and Bajaj Auto, are reportedly waiting for the tender process to begin. Since the order could involve 50,000 scooters at once, companies may have to supply vehicles at significantly discounted rates. 25 lakh tablets and smartphones also planned Alongside the scooter scheme, the government is also accelerating the ‘Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme’. Under the initiative, over 25 lakh tablets and smartphones are expected to be distributed before the elections. The Yogi government claims that more than 60 lakh digital devices have already been distributed so far. ‘BJP strengthening its women voter base’ Senior journalist Anand Rai said welfare schemes targeting girls and women have historically created a positive political impact in Uttar Pradesh. He pointed out that former Chief Minister Mulayam Singh Yadav had launched the ‘Kanya Vidya Dhan Yojana’ in 2003, which received strong public support among women voters. According to Rai, the BJP remains highly focused on consolidating its women voter base through such initiatives.

stories.title: Drug mafia accused loses ₹3 crore assets:Police seal home and warehouse with drum beats; scooter taken into custody
stories.summary: Meerut police on Tuesday confiscated property worth ₹3 crore belonging to alleged drug dealer Ishu in the Brahmapuri area. The police sealed his house and cowshed while drums were played during the action. Police teams remained at the spot for more than two hours and also made public announcements during the operation. Ishu is also an accused in a double murder case. Meerut Police is continuously taking action against criminals. It is imposing the Gangster Act on gang-related criminals. The Gangster Act proceedings were initiated so that their illegally acquired properties could be attached. Similarly, action has also been taken against a criminal named Ishu, son of Karan Singh, a resident of Brahmapuri Ambedkar Nagar, who had accumulated properties through the illegal drug trade. Gangster action taken on October 28 On October 28, 2025, a gang was registered at Brahmapuri police station by the then SHO Ramakant Pachauri, which included Ishu son of Karan Singh, Vikas Jatav son of Charan Singh, Brijmohan son of Mahipal Singh, and Nitin son of Nepal Singh. This gang had been acquiring property through the illegal drug trade for a long time. Police investigation revealed that the accused had been active in drug trafficking for a long time and was pushing youth into the quagmire of addiction. Several cases, including murder, theft, Goonda Act, and Gangster Act, along with the NDPS Act, were already registered against the accused. People in a stir after seeing heavy force Today, under the direction of SSP Meerut Avinash Pandey, this major action was taken under the leadership of SP City Vinayak Gopal Bhosle and Circle Officer Brahmapuri Saumya Asthana. The Paratapur police station, along with heavy police force, administrative officers, and the tehsil team, carried out the action by making announcements with drums and trumpets. After this, people were informed about the upcoming action through the public announcement system. Seizure boards were put up at the spot, and the properties were duly sealed and attached. Among the properties attached are a luxurious house in Prem Vihar worth approximately 1 crore 70 lakh rupees, another house in Lisadi village worth approximately 1 crore 10 lakh rupees, and a Honda Activa scooter. The total value of the property is estimated to be approximately 2 crore 80 lakh 70 thousand rupees. Property worth 3 crore attached after public proclamation First, an announcement was made in the presence of the Naib Tehsildar. In no time, a crowd of people gathered. After this, the police sealed Ishu's residence in Brahmapuri, a warehouse in Lohianagar, and a scooter. CO Saumya Asthana said that the three properties that have been attached and sealed are worth approximately three crore rupees. Ishu is also accused of a double murder case Ishu's name also surfaced in Meerut's infamous double murder case. After the death of retired Head Constable Ratan Singh Sirohi, a resident of Bibinagar, Bulandshahr, his wife Kaushal Chaudhary and 12-year-old granddaughter Tamanna were murdered with a sharp weapon on the night of August 8, 2022, at their home in Shastri Nagar, Nauchandi police station area. In this sensational incident, the names of his daughter Sneha and her husband Ishu came to light. It was reported that this horrific incident was carried out due to the greed for property worth approximately 2 crore rupees. Police investigation also revealed that after the death of Sneha's first husband, her daughter Tamanna's name was registered for the in-laws' property and land. This property fueled the greed, and then the entire family was stained with blood.

stories.title: Bakrid holiday shifted to May 28 in UP:Yogi government changes date; Maulana urges people not to offer namaz on roads
stories.summary: In Uttar Pradesh, the public holiday for Eid-ul-Adha, popularly known as Bakrid, has been shifted from May 27 to May 28. The Yogi government issued revised orders on Tuesday, stating that all government offices and banks will remain open on May 27 and closed on May 28 instead. According to the updated notification issued by Chief Secretary of General Administration SVS Ranga Rao, the decision was taken in view of the moon sighting and the revised date of the festival. Meanwhile, Muslim religious leaders have appealed to people not to offer namaz on roads to ensure that traffic movement is not disrupted. They also urged citizens to maintain cleanliness during Bakrid and follow guidelines while performing animal sacrifice. Religious leaders advised that sacrifices should be carried out only at designated places and that animal remains should not be disposed of in the open. Shahi Mufti of Aligarh, Maulana Ibrahim Hussain, said people should celebrate the festival peacefully while fully cooperating with the administration. Permission to pray on the road should not be given not only on Eid but on other days as well. Islam does not teach us to cause trouble to anyone. Roads are public. Everyone has a share in them. Shia religious leader says- We should not even look at cows with raised eyes Shia religious leader Maulana Saif Abbas said, on Bakrid you should perform sacrifice. In our country's constitution, only those animals whose sacrifice is permitted should be sacrificed. We should not even look at cows with raised eyes because our Hindu brothers worship them. He warned that if any person sacrifices a cow, they will be working against Islam. Islam says that other religions should be respected. There is no need to sacrifice cows. Before Bakrid, Yogi had said- Will not allow namaz on roads A week ago, CM Yogi gave a strict warning regarding namaz on roads. He had said that namaz will not be allowed on roads. If they agree with love, fine, if they don't agree, then another method will be adopted. Yogi said, If you want to read namaz, read it at a designated place. If the numbers are more, read it in shifts. We will not stop namaz, but we will not allow anarchy on the roads. Roads are not for reading namaz or gathering crowds of any kind. He said- People ask me whether namaz happens on roads in UP? I say- absolutely not. Roads are for common people to walk on. No one has the right to come and disturb traffic. Yogi further said, "Those people told me that sir, how will it happen, our numbers are more. We said- if you don't have space to live in your house, then control the population. If you don't have the capacity, then why is the population being increased unnecessarily? Everyone will have to live within the system. Everyone will have to accept the rule of law." Raised issue of namaz on roads during election campaign in Bengal CM Yogi had raised the issue of namaz on roads during the recently concluded West Bengal Assembly election campaign. Accusing former Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee of politics of appeasement, he had said that Didi makes people read namaz on roads. She imposes restrictions on Hindu festivals. In UP, no one can read namaz on roads. Roads are for traffic, not for namaz. No curfew, no riots, everything is fine in UP. Yogi government had imposed ban on reading namaz on roads The Yogi government completely banned namaz on roads in 2022-23. Orders were issued that namaz would not be offered on roads on Eid, Alvida Jumma or any other day. Religious events should only take place inside Eidgahs, mosques or designated religious places.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav raises issue of fake encounters in state:Claims UP govt's bulldozer action is caste-based; BJP asks, ‘Why so much pain?’
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav raised the issue of fake encounters in Lucknow on Tuesday. He said, encounters in UP are a huge conspiracy. The way people sitting in the government are using their power is visible. Those conducting fake encounters are not the government, they are criminals. If any encounter has ulterior motives behind it, then understand that it is fake. Akhilesh said, policemen involved in fake encounters should definitely think about how the government is using them for its own benefit. It is turning them from officers into criminals. Policemen involved in fake encounters know that they are doing illegal work. Many police personnel conducting such fake encounters even become mentally ill. They kill others in a moment and themselves die bit by bit. The SP chief raised the issue of the 2021 Jaunpur Pujari Yadav encounter and said, when police get caught in fake encounters, the BJP government turns its face away from them. When policemen go to jail, their family members become victims of social humiliation. Where the public conducts their social encounter. BJP spokesperson Rakesh Tripathi has hit back at Akhilesh Yadav. He said, What is Akhilesh's relationship with criminals? The injury is to the criminal, but the pain is felt by Akhilesh. After every encounter, the pain of criminals is expressed through Akhilesh Yadav's tongue. The elimination of crime and criminals is necessary for society.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Bus accident on Lucknow-Agra Expressway kills 7; Australia raises Hormuz concerns at Quad meet in Delhi more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top headlines: 1. Australia raises Hormuz concerns at Quad meet in Delhi The Quad foreign ministers’ meeting concluded in New Delhi, with Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong expressing concern over tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and their impact on global oil and energy supplies. 2. Seven killed as bus overturns on Lucknow-Agra Expressway Seven people, including a Bihar Police sub-inspector and a prisoner in custody, were killed after a double-decker AC bus overturned on the Lucknow-Agra Expressway in Uttar Pradesh’s Unnao early Tuesday morning. The Delhi-to-Bihar bus carrying 36 passengers reportedly crashed into a divider near Auras police station after the driver allegedly fell asleep at the wheel. The vehicle overturned and several passengers were thrown out onto the road. 3. UP fuel smuggled into Nepal, border districts face shortage Petrol pumps across seven UP districts bordering Nepal are running dry as fuel allegedly bought at ₹100 per litre in India is being smuggled into Nepal and sold for nearly ₹135. Long queues, supply disruptions and illegal cross-border transport have triggered a fuel crisis in the region. 4. After petrol and diesel, CNG dearer by ₹2 Amid the Iran war, the price of compressed natural gas (CNG) has risen for the fourth time in the last two weeks. Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) increased CNG prices by ₹2 per kilogram on Tuesday, May 26. 5. CM Yogi targets SP rule; recalls people drying clothes on electric wires Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said that during the Samajwadi Party government, people used to dry clothes on electricity wires as power supply remained erratic, with electricity available at odd hours. He said the same people are now trying to make a political issue over the power cuts during the global energy crisis. 6. BJP bets on 57,000 Gram Pradhans ahead of UP polls In a first for Uttar Pradesh, the Yogi Adityanath government has handed administrative powers of Gram Panchayats to village heads instead of bureaucrats ahead of Assembly elections. The move aims to speed up rural development work, reduce pressure on officials and strengthen BJP’s grassroots booth network across 57,000 villages. 7. Iran claims downing of US MQ-9 drone over Hormuz Iran has claimed it shot down a US MQ-9B drone and opened fire at a fighter jet that entered Iranian airspace. According to a report by Al Jazeera, Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said its forces targeted an RQ-4 drone and an intruding F-35 fighter aircraft. 8. Four killed as Innova crashes into trailer on Barabanki highway Four friends travelling to Kainchi Dham were killed and three others critically injured after their speeding Innova rammed into a trailer on the Lucknow-Sultanpur Highway in Uttar Pradesh’s Barabanki early Tuesday. Police suspect the driver fell asleep before the SUV crashed into the vehicle from behind. 9. Rape accused's throat slit in Gorakhpur: Body packed in a sack thrown into river In Gorakhpur, a young man was murdered, and his body was stuffed into a sack and thrown into the Ami River. The next morning, seeing the sack floating, people informed the police. With the help of local people, the police pulled out the sack and opened it, finding the body of a young man. There were deep wounds on his neck. His hands were tied. With the help of a sticker on his clothes, the young man was identified as Aditya Sahni of Sahjanwa. The police informed his family. 10. Ranveer Singh banned by FWICE over ‘Don 3’ exit Ranveer Singh has landed in controversy after dropping out of Farhan Akhtar's film Don 3. Following Farhan Akhtar's complaint, FWICE (Film Federation of Western Cine Employees) banned the actor on Monday. He will not be able to do any film until the Don 3 controversy is resolved.

stories.title: SSC exam chaos in Prayagraj:Students vandalize centre, block highway over server failure; new exam date to be announced soon
stories.summary: During the SSC-GD recruitment examination held in Prayagraj on Tuesday, candidates created a ruckus when the server failed. The examination was scheduled to be held in three shifts (First: 10 to 11 AM, Second: 1 to 2 PM, and Third: 4:30 to 5:30 PM) at Sunita Singh Sita Singh College, located in Andawa. The first shift examination started at the scheduled time of 10 AM. There were 600 candidates for this, but only 450 candidates were present. As soon as the examination began, the computer server went down. At this, the candidates started creating a ruckus. They started breaking the computers and chairs kept in the rooms. They started shouting slogans. After this, at around 11:35 AM, students also blocked the Prayagraj-Varanasi Highway. Police, who arrived at the scene, managed to calm the situation with great difficulty after half an hour. Following the commotion, today's examination was cancelled. The incident falls under the Sarai Inayat police station area. See 2 pictures of the commotion Sanjay Gupta, the in-charge inspector of Sarai Inayat Police Station, stated- It has come to light that several computers and classroom furniture have been damaged. The police have started investigating the incident. Legal action will be taken after identifying the students who indulged in vandalism. Additionally, steps are being taken to call a technical team to investigate the server-related issue and to reschedule the examination. SSC Regional Head Ashish Kumar Srivastava said - The loss caused due to technical glitch in the examination will be assessed and a report will be sent to the education department and the concerned examination authority. Candidates should also maintain peace. Also, today's exam has been cancelled. The new date for the exam will be announced soon. Meanwhile, local villagers and traffic police said - Vehicle drivers faced problems due to the jam. But, traffic was restored soon. Students had also created a ruckus on May 25 On Monday, a similar incident of vandalism occurred at the I-Tech Zone examination center of Sunita Singh Sita Singh Women's College in Prayagraj. In the second shift (1 PM to 2 PM), candidates created a ruckus when twice the number of examinees allocated to the center arrived. During this, hundreds of computer systems, monitors, ACs, coolers, CCTVs, servers, jammers, and water coolers, along with other equipment in several rooms, were broken. After this, they went to GT Road and blocked the traffic. Traffic remained halted for about an hour. Police forces who arrived at the scene brought the situation under control and pacified the protesters. During this, the police also took a student into custody who was fleeing with a laptop. Responsibility of examination center to Bengaluru firm SSC Central Region had entrusted the responsibility of conducting the examination to Bengaluru-based Eduquity Career Technologies Private Limited. The center management informed that a total of 650 computer systems were available at the I-Tech Zone Center in Andawa. However, in the second shift, 1035 examinees instead of 505, and in the third shift, 1034 examinees instead of 495, were allotted the same center. The center received allocation information via e-mail only on Monday. This led to a breakdown in arrangements. Exams Cancelled at 5 Centers Including Prayagraj Citing technical reasons, SSC Central Region had cancelled the second and third shift exams on Monday at some centers in Prayagraj, Kanpur, Lucknow, Gorakhpur, and Muzaffarnagar. The commission stated that all affected candidates will have their exams re-conducted. New admit cards will also be issued on the website soon. The list of canceled examinations includes SMT Ramkali Iqbal Bahadur Online Center in Kanpur, City Modern Academy in Lucknow, Maharshi IT Institute Online Examination Center in Gorakhpur, and Adarsh Pariksha Kendra in Muzaffarnagar, in addition to Prayagraj.

stories.title: Storm in UP, roof tanks blown away:Trees uprooted, 6 dead; heatwave alert in 39 districts
stories.summary: Today is the second day of Nautapa in UP. Early Tuesday morning, a storm hit Lakhimpur Kheri. Trees and poles were uprooted. Roof tanks of houses were blown away. Most districts remained cloudy in the morning. The sun kept appearing intermittently. As the day progressed, the heat increased. Hot winds gained momentum. Today there is a heatwave alert in 39 cities. Among these, 3 cities - Banda, Chitrakoot and Prayagraj - are on red alert. This means very hot winds will blow here. Before this, late Monday night the weather suddenly changed. A storm with a speed of 90 hit Lucknow. Such strong storms also hit Basti, Gorakhpur and Gonda that thousands of trees and poles were uprooted. In Gonda, Lakhimpur, Basti, Shahjahanpur and Sitapur, 6 people including children died in accidents related to storm and rain. Heavy rain accompanied by strong winds also occurred in Badaun, Ayodhya, Unnao, and Sambhal. The Meteorological Department informed - A major change in weather will be seen from May 28. There will be storms, dust storms and cloudy skies. There will be good rainfall across the entire state for 2-3 days. The temperature will drop by 8C-10C. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda once again remained the hottest city in the country. The maximum temperature was recorded at 47.6C. In Maharashtra's Brahmapuri, the mercury stood at 47.6C. In Jhansi, the mercury reached 46C. Temperature was recorded at 45.8C in Jalaun, 45.5C in Agra, and 45.4C in Prayagraj. See pictures- How is there rain between no disturbance and Nautapa? Meteorologists say that the temperature in UP has been very high for the past few days. Due to intense heat, a large difference has developed between the ground and upper air temperatures. Apart from this, a trough line (an imaginary line creating a low-pressure area) is active from eastern UP to Chhattisgarh. A cyclonic wind zone has formed over south Bihar. A weather system is also active over Jammu-Kashmir and its surrounding areas. Due to this, the weather in UP has changed. Favorable conditions have developed for storms and rain. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh informed- A new western disturbance will become active on May 28. Cyclonic wind conditions persist at higher altitudes in south Bihar and surrounding areas. In such a situation, there may be storms, rain along with lightning on May 29 and 30 in the state. Wind speed can reach up to 50 km/hour. What will the weather be like for the next 5 days?

stories.title: Rape accused's throat slit in Gorakhpur:Body packed in a sack thrown into river; deceased identified by clothes
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, a young man was murdered, and his body was stuffed into a sack and thrown into the Ami River. The next morning, seeing the sack floating, people informed the police. With the help of local people, the police pulled out the sack and opened it, finding the body of a young man. There were deep wounds on his neck. His hands were tied. With the help of a sticker on his clothes, the young man was identified as Aditya Sahni of Sahjanwa. The police informed his family. During the investigation, it was revealed that a young woman had filed a report against Aditya for molestation on May 21. Five years ago, she had filed a rape report against him and sent him to jail. That young woman got married only last month. These days she is at her maternal home. Aditya's maternal grandparents' home is also in her maternal village. Angered by the molestation report, Aditya had stormed her house and created a ruckus two days ago on Sunday. Enraged by the same incident, the girl's family members caught Aditya. They set his bike on fire. After that, Aditya did not return home. The next morning, his body was found in the river. The investigation revealed that enraged by him breaking into their house and assaulting them, the girl's family members slit his throat and murdered him. Then, they stuffed the body into a sack and threw it into the Ami River. This incident is from the Gida police station area. The police have registered a report against 23 people. Five have been taken into custody and are being interrogated. See 3 pictures Now know the full case in detail Closeness with girl grew at maternal grandparents' house, she accused him of rape Rajesh Sahni, a resident of Tikaria village in Sahjanwa police station area, works in paint-polish in Hyderabad. His son Aditya Sahni (26) lived in his maternal grandparents' village in a nearby village of Khajni. Due to the poor financial condition of the family, he also used to go to Hyderabad with them for work. He used to visit his maternal grandparents' house frequently, which led to him getting acquainted with a girl there. Initially, the families ignored it, but later the dispute escalated. The two had been in a love relationship for a long time, but the family was not agreeable to their relationship. Due to this, there were arguments between both families many times. On June 1, 2021, the girl filed a case of rape against Aditya at Khajni police station. The young woman alleged that Aditya had forcibly made physical relations. Aditya was jailed in this case. Later, after getting bail, he came out of jail and went to Hyderabad with his father. He started working there with his father. Came to the village 10 days ago, the young woman was also at her maternal home Aditya had come to his village from Hyderabad just 10 days ago. The young woman who accused him of rape was married on April 20 last month. On May 17, she had come to her maternal home. Aditya was also present in the same village that day. On May 21, the same young woman again filed a case against Aditya at Khajni police station, accusing him of molestation. It is alleged that Aditya, angered by the registration of the case, attacked the girl's family with eight to ten companions on the night of Sunday, May 24. They broke into the house, assaulted the women, and destroyed household items including TV and fridge. Two women were seriously injured in the incident. When villagers arrived hearing the noise, Aditya and his companions fled from there. Later, the girl's family members chased Aditya, caught him near Katghar intersection, and set his bike on fire. After this, they beat Aditya and took him away with them. As soon as this information was received, the police became active. Body found in a sack in the river under the bridge, identified by clothes Police continued to raid throughout Sunday night, but Aditya could not be found. On the morning of May 25, Aditya's body was found wrapped in a sack under the Ami River bridge in Bharsand, Gida area. His hands and feet were tied, and deep marks of being slit with a sharp weapon were found on his throat. Aditya's shirt had a tailor's sticker, through which Aditya was easily identified. SP North Gyanendra Kumar said- On the complaint of Aditya's mother, Sanju Devi, a case has been registered at Khajni police station against 13 named and 10 unknown persons under serious sections including murder and rioting. Five people have been taken into custody and are being interrogated.

stories.title: Crorepati son-in-law opens fire at in-laws:Mother-in-law, brother-in-law shot at son’s birthday party amid divorce battle
stories.summary: In a posh area of Muzaffarnagar, a millionaire son-in-law opened indiscriminate fire on his in-laws during his son's birthday party on Monday night. Bullets hit 3 women including mother-in-law and sister-in-law. All three fell on the floor drenched in blood. They started groaning in pain. After the firing, chaos erupted at the scene. Relatives and friends who had come to the party started fleeing to save their lives. Some saved their lives by hiding in rooms inside the house. Some ran out of the house. Hearing the screams, neighbors informed the police. When police arrived, the son-in-law was found standing at the spot with a licensed revolver in his hand. The policemen snatched the revolver from the accused and took him to the police station. The injured women were admitted to the district hospital. As their condition was critical, all three were referred to Meerut. The incident is from Panchsheel Colony in Civil Line police station area. According to police, the son-in-law had come from Dehradun to his in-laws' place in Muzaffarnagar to celebrate his son's birthday. He has a divorce case pending with his wife. During the party, after an argument with his wife, he opened fire. See visuals from the scene Now understand the entire matter in a sequential manner- 5 rounds of firing in 12 minutes, condition of injured critical SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma said- The investigation revealed that the son-in-law fired 5 rounds of bullets in 12 minutes. Upon checking his revolver, it was found that he could not fire more due to two bullets getting jammed in the chamber. 8 live cartridges were also recovered from Anant. The FSL team has collected evidence from the spot. All three injured women are undergoing treatment in Meerut. Their condition is critical.
